title: Beneficiary Liability Under the Tier's Inpatient Basis - Corrected TRICARE Select Stays
content:
**Clause.** Under the **TRICARE Select** tier's inpatient basis for the facility's network relationship on the admission date, the beneficiary liability on a corrected stay with a covered day is figured as follows: where the basis is lesser of per diem or percent, it is the lesser of the daily charge times the covered days and the stated percent of the amount cost-shared; where it is per diem with minimum, it is the daily charge times the covered days but never less than the tier's network minimum charge; where it is percent of allowed, it is the stated percent of the amount cost-shared; otherwise, under per admission copayment, it is the tier's network admission copayment once; each figure is rounded to the cent. A corrected stay with no covered day carries no beneficiary liability.

A facility in the network on the admission date takes the network basis, daily charge and percent; any other facility takes the non-network ones.

## Tier figures (US dollars; percent of the amount cost-shared)

| Tier | Network basis | Network daily charge | Network minimum charge | Network admission copayment | Network percent | Non-network basis | Non-network daily charge | Non-network percent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | per diem with minimum | 21.15 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0 | per diem with minimum | 21.15 | 0 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | per diem with minimum | 21.15 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0 | per diem with minimum | 21.15 | 0 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | per admission copayment | 0.00 | 0.00 | 76.00 | 0 | percent of allowed | 0.00 | 20 |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | per admission copayment | 0.00 | 0.00 | 76.00 | 0 | percent of allowed | 0.00 | 20 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | lesser of per diem or percent | 250.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 20 | lesser of per diem or percent | 1191.00 | 25 |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | per admission copayment | 0.00 | 0.00 | 201.00 | 0 | percent of allowed | 0.00 | 25 |

The minimum under per diem with minimum is the network minimum charge whether the facility is in the network or not.

## Hypothetical stays

- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, network, 3 covered days, amount cost-shared 6000.00: the lesser of 750.00 and 1200.00 (20 percent): 750.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, non-network, 2 covered days, amount cost-shared 4000.00: the lesser of 2382.00 and 1000.00 (25 percent): 1000.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group A, network, 2 covered days, amount cost-shared 3000.00: the lesser of 500.00 and 600.00 (20 percent): 500.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, non-network, amount cost-shared 2400.00: 25 percent, 600.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network: 201.00 once, whatever the number of covered days.
